Name: DBB's Victorian Gothic Tools
Author: donutbunnybunny
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=3]This is a retexture mod for some tools to match my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35996]victorian gothic UI[/url].

You can customize tools in your desired colors through the mod configuration, also you can disable the unwanted textures using the toggles.

If you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25258]Colorful Fishing Rods[/url], you can match the colors of the fishing rods.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/HIThLGc.png[/img]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]: automatically replaces textures
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url]: automatically replaces textures
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]: assets for replacement exists

To change the texture of the fashion sense hand mirror, go to the following path: [CP] DBB's victorian gothic tools\assets\_compatibility\FashionSense
Select the mirror color you want, and rename the image to HandMirror.png
Go to the following path: FashionSense\Framework\Assets, and overwrite

Thank all the original mod authors!
